title: Prime Video to Release 'Madden' Biopic Starring Nicolas Cage
description: Prime Video is set to release the 'Madden' biopic featuring Nicolas Cage in November, according to multiple sources.

sections.heading: Madden Biopic Details
paragraphs: The 'Madden' biopic, starring Nicolas Cage, is scheduled for release on Prime Video in November. The film is directed by David O. Russell.

sections.heading: Release Date
paragraphs: According to NBC Sports, the 'Madden' movie will make its Prime Video debut on November 18.

sections.heading: Nicolas Cage's Role
paragraphs: The Hollywood Reporter quotes Nicolas Cage, who describes his role in the 'Madden' biopic as a 'highlight for me'.
